scale_title: How would you like to rate?
scale_subtitle: Pick whatever feels natural. You can change this later, and past records keep the scale they were taken on.
scale_numeric5_hint: Five steps. Enough room to separate values without agonising over each card.
scale_numeric10_hint: Ten steps. Finer distinctions, and a longer decision on every card.
scale_qualitative_hint: Three levels. The quickest way through the deck.
assessment_finish_partial: You can finish now — unrated values are simply left out of this record.
assessment_exit_message: Your answers so far are already saved. You can pick up where you left off.
assessment_recalibration_notice: You already calibrated today. Finishing overwrites that record.
assessment_new_record_notice: This will be saved as a new record for {{date}}.
assessment_prefilled_notice: Starting from your last answers — change what has moved.
assessment_saved_new: Saved as a new record for {{date}}.
assessment_no_values: There are no values in your deck. Restore some in Settings.
results_empty_body: Rate the value cards once and your ranking appears here.
results_unrated_hint: {{count}} values were left unrated in this record.
history_empty_body: Your calibrations will be listed here as you record them.
history_needs_two_body: Recalibrate another day and this screen will show what moved.
history_nothing_moved: Nothing moved between these two calibrations.
history_chart_hint: Tap a value below to follow its line.
history_delete_confirm_message: The record for {{date}} and all of its ratings are removed. This cannot be undone.
settings_scale_notice: Applies to your next calibration. Records already taken keep their own scale.
settings_recalibrate_today: Today is already recorded — recalibrating overwrites it.
settings_recalibrate_past: Last calibration {{date}}. A new one today is saved as its own record.
settings_values_hint: {{active}} of {{total}} values are in the deck
values_deck_hint: Archived values stay in your past records but are not dealt in new calibrations.
deck_delete_confirm_message: It is removed from the deck along with every rating it collected. This cannot be undone.
reset_data_hint: Deletes every calibration and restores the default value deck.
reset_confirm_message: Every calibration and every value you added is deleted. This cannot be undone.
storage_memory_warning: This browser isn't keeping your data — it will be gone when you close the tab.
value_learning_desc: Taking in new knowledge and skills on purpose.
value_curiosity_desc: Following what interests you without needing a reason.
value_self_awareness_desc: Knowing your own patterns, motives and limits.
value_mastery_desc: Becoming genuinely good at something over years.
value_creativity_desc: Making things that did not exist before.
value_adaptability_desc: Changing course when the situation changes.
value_courage_desc: Acting while afraid, instead of waiting for the fear to pass.
value_open_mindedness_desc: Weighing a view you did not arrive with.
value_patience_desc: Waiting for what matters without forcing it.
value_self_control_desc: Acting on your own ideals rather than the impulse.
value_family_desc: Closeness with the people you are bound to.
value_friendship_desc: Deep, chosen relationships kept up over years.
value_love_desc: Intimacy and devotion with a partner.
value_community_desc: Being part of a group with a shared life.
value_loyalty_desc: Standing by people when it costs you something.
value_belonging_desc: Being somewhere you are accepted as you are.
value_connection_desc: Being fully in what you are doing, with whoever is there.
value_cooperation_desc: Getting things done with people rather than around them.
value_forgiveness_desc: Letting go of a debt, your own included.
value_friendliness_desc: Being warm and easy with the people you meet.
value_intimacy_desc: Opening up to someone, emotionally and physically.
value_respect_desc: Treating yourself and others as worth the courtesy.
value_achievement_desc: Setting goals and actually reaching them.
value_ambition_desc: Wanting more, and moving toward it.
value_recognition_desc: Being seen and credited for your work.
value_excellence_desc: Working to a standard you are proud of.
value_leadership_desc: Taking responsibility for where a group goes.
value_prosperity_desc: Having enough money to choose freely.
value_diligence_desc: Giving the work in front of you your full effort.
value_persistence_desc: Carrying on with what you started once it gets hard.
value_health_desc: Looking after your body for the long run.
value_balance_desc: Keeping work, rest and people in proportion.
value_calm_desc: A settled mind, not easily thrown.
value_humour_desc: Not taking things heavier than they are.
value_acceptance_desc: Letting yourself, other people and events be as they are.
value_mindfulness_desc: Being here, now, and interested in it.
value_sensuality_desc: Seeking out pleasure and letting yourself enjoy it.

value_helping_desc: Being useful to people who need it.
value_compassion_desc: Feeling with others, and acting on it.
value_generosity_desc: Giving time, money or attention freely.
value_justice_desc: Wanting things to be fair, and saying so.
value_stewardship_desc: Leaving the world in a better state than you found it.

value_independence_desc: Relying on yourself for what you need.
value_adventure_desc: Choosing the unfamiliar over the safe.

value_exploration_desc: Seeing places and ideas you have not seen.
value_assertiveness_desc: Asking for what you want, plainly and respectfully.
value_stability_desc: A life that holds its shape.
